label: For every candidate-description carrier, two frames E and M, and origin w, all-predicate diamond…
paraphrase: For every candidate-description carrier, two frames E and M, and origin w, all-predicate diamond transfer from E to M holds exactly when E-accessibility at w is included in M-accessibility; the equivalent box transfer runs from M to E. A two-description equivalence-frame control has a satisfiable E-possible description excluded by M at the origin, and separates the corresponding boxes of its negation.
